name: @arnilo/prism
description: Agent harness for AI providers, agents, sessions, and tools.

scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun run --workspaces --if-present typecheck && tsc -p examples --noEmit
scripts.test:coverage: bun scripts/with-build-lock.mjs bun test --coverage --timeout=0 --path-ignore-patterns=packages/** src > node_modules/.prism-core-coverage.out 2>&1; core_exit=$?; cat node_modules/.prism-core-coverage.out; PRISM_COVERAGE_CORE_OUTPUT=node_modules/.prism-core-coverage.out PRISM_COVERAGE_CORE_EXIT=$core_exit bun scripts/with-build-lock.mjs bun scripts/coverage-summary.mjs && bun test --timeout=0 scripts/phase23-coverage.test.mjs && bun test --timeout=0 scripts/phase23-skip-manifest.test.mjs; stage_exit=$?; rm -f node_modules/.prism-core-coverage.out; if [ $core_exit -ne 0 ]; then echo "core coverage run failed (exit $core_exit)" >&2; exit $core_exit; fi; exit $stage_exit
scripts.pack:dry-run: bun pm pack --dry-run && bun run --filter '*' pack:dry-run
scripts.test:postgres:run: bun scripts/require-postgres-url.mjs && bun run --filter @arnilo/prism-extensions test:postgres && bun run --filter @arnilo/prism-hosts test:postgres && bun test --timeout=0 scripts/phase7-conformance.test.mjs scripts/phase22-conformance.test.mjs
scripts.sdk:ready: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run test:coverage && bun run pack:dry-run && bun run release:gate
scripts.release:gate: bun scripts/release-skip-manifest.mjs && bun scripts/host-builder-index.mjs --check && bun scripts/check-client-neutrality.mjs && bun run --filter @arnilo/prism-agent test && bun run --filter @arnilo/prism-hosts test && bun examples/adapters/conformance.ts && bun test --timeout=0 src/__tests__/driver-kit-vendor-neutral.test.ts src/__tests__/kernel-constraints.test.ts src/__tests__/host-builder-kit.test.ts && bun scripts/package-skills-conformance.mjs && bun test --timeout=0 scripts/install-idempotence.test.mjs && bun scripts/release.mjs gate
scripts.security:threat-suites: bun test --timeout=0 scripts/phase8-conformance.test.mjs scripts/phase9-conformance.test.mjs scripts/phase11-conformance.test.mjs scripts/phase20-security.test.mjs scripts/phase21-security.test.mjs scripts/phase22-security.test.mjs scripts/phase23-security.test.mjs scripts/phase38-codeql-regression.test.mjs src/__tests__/pinned-fetch.test.ts
